bills.title: Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Closing Loopholes No. 2) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-02-07.172.2): > *That so much of the standing orders be suspended as would prevent me moving a motion to provide for the consideration of a matter, namely a motion to allow a motion concerning the [Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Closing Loopholes No. 2) Bill 2023](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7134) to be moved and determined immediately.* Standing orders are the usual procedural rules of Parliament.
